criteria.requirement: Fix lint.Filter(require_matching_tags=True) to assert that the open-element stack is empty only after full source exhaustion, detecting truncated final/nested StartTag streams. Unmatched EndTag must raise the documented AssertionError rather than raw IndexError. Preserve lazy yielded prefixes, source/token identity, balanced HTML/foreign namespace/void streams and explicit require_matching_tags=False fragments. Do not auto-close, consume the source twice or change serializer/tree-parser recovery semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
